headline: Gold Price Today: Gold Becomes This Expensive on October 1 in UP, Bihar, Delhi; Price Rises This Much Ahead of Shraddh
summary: Gold and silver prices rose on October 1, with bullion gold climbing by up to Rs 150. Rising US-Iran tensions are considered a major reason for the rally.
why: Gold is a traditional safe-haven asset that often gains when geopolitical risk rises. India is one of the largest gold consumers, so domestic prices track global bullion moves.
